Class CompositeDrawable

Namespace: osu.Framework.Graphics.Containers
Assembly: osu.Framework.dll

A drawable consisting of a composite of child drawables which are managed by the composite object itself. Transformations applied to a osu.Framework.Graphics.Containers.CompositeDrawable are also applied to its children. Additionally, osu.Framework.Graphics.Containers.CompositeDrawables support various effects, such as masking, edge effect, padding, and automatic sizing depending on their children.

AutoSizeAxes

Controls which osu.Framework.Graphics.Axes are automatically sized w.r.t. osu.Framework.Graphics.Containers.CompositeDrawable.InternalChildren. Children's osu.Framework.Graphics.Drawable.BypassAutoSizeAxes are ignored for automatic sizing. Most notably, osu.Framework.Graphics.Drawable.RelativePositionAxes and osu.Framework.Graphics.Containers.CompositeDrawable.RelativeSizeAxes of children do not affect automatic sizing to avoid circular size dependencies. It is not allowed to manually set osu.Framework.Graphics.Containers.CompositeDrawable.Size (or osu.Framework.Graphics.Containers.CompositeDrawable.Width / osu.Framework.Graphics.Containers.CompositeDrawable.Height) on any osu.Framework.Graphics.Axes which are automatically sized.

public virtual Axes AutoSizeAxes { get; protected set; }

Property Value

Axes

BorderThickness

Determines how thick of a border to draw around the inside of the masked region. Only has an effect when osu.Framework.Graphics.Containers.CompositeDrawable.Masking is true. The border only is drawn on top of children using a sprite shader.

CornerExponent

Determines how gentle the curve of the corner straightens. A value of 2 (default) results in circular arcs, a value of 2.5 results in something closer to apple's "continuous corner". Values between 2 and 10 result in varying degrees of "continuousness", where larger values are smoother. Values between 1 and 2 result in a "flatter" appearance than round corners. Values between 0 and 1 result in a concave, round corner as opposed to a convex round corner, where a value of 0.5 is a circular concave arc. Only has an effect when osu.Framework.Graphics.Containers.CompositeDrawable.Masking is true and osu.Framework.Graphics.Containers.CompositeDrawable.CornerRadius is non-zero.

public float CornerExponent { get; protected set; }
